title: EI Drag and Drop Activity
notes: This is a drag and drop activity for use in moodle for elearning on emotional intelligence.
html:
Emotional Intelligence in Practice

Goleman's Four Domains of Emotional Intelligence

Instructions

Read each workplace scenario. Drag the emotional intelligence domain into the matching space.

Think about the skill being demonstrated rather than simply the emotion being experienced.

Scenario 1: Receiving feedback

A support worker notices that they become defensive when receiving feedback. They reflect on why this happens and recognise how their feelings influence their behaviour.

Domain: [[1]]

Scenario 2: Managing a difficult interaction

During an aggressive interaction, a worker remains calm, regulates their emotions and follows appropriate de-escalation procedures.

Domain: [[2]]

Scenario 3: Recognising emotional needs

A peer worker notices that a participant has become unusually withdrawn. They consider how the participant might be feeling and respond with sensitivity.

Domain: [[3]]

Scenario 4: Resolving team conflict

Two colleagues disagree about a support plan. A team leader facilitates respectful discussion and helps them reach a shared agreement.

Domain: [[4]]

Reflection

Emotional intelligence is not simply about controlling emotions. It involves recognising emotions, understanding their influence, responding effectively and building healthy relationships.
